title: row13
live_proof: inspection with line numbers in the 3.22.0 tree: sqlite3Fts3Offsets() saves a poslist pointer per phrase and reads it at fts3_snippet.c:1544, while fts3EvalRestart at fts3.c:5540 frees and reloads already-visited doclists. Fixed upstream in 3.49.0
object: the per-phrase poslist buffers sqlite3Fts3Offsets() saved pointers into
lifetime_ender: an incremental phrase restarts the NEAR group, so fts3EvalRestart frees and reloads the doclists those pointers refer to
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator: offsets() over an OR of phrases read incrementally. Built in the fts3 group

sublet.oracle: VM HALTED on a capability fault, cause 24 untagged dereference (temporal: revoked, or never a capability) pc=0x800239e4 -- taken outside the domain, so cooperative recovery has no frame to return through; all 28 halts in this arm are at the same kernel pc 0x800239e4

cheribsd-revocation.oracle: CheriBSD 15.0-CURRENT riscv64-purecap, memsys5 over the case's static arena (shared/run-cheribsd.py --mode nested). Revocation acts on a guest malloc free, and under memsys5 there is none: sqlite3_free returns the block to memsys5's own pool inside one array the guest allocator sees as a single live object. So a tag fault here is NOT revocation reporting -- SIGPROT(34) with si_code=2 at the function host ASan reported (fault_sites) is recorded as a catch by the same rule the virtual arms use, and the note says what actually cleared the tag. A fault anywhere else is not tied to the defect

status: all three arms run; spatial and sublet 2026-10-04 with the gaps closed 2026-10-05, cheribsd-revocation 2026-10-04 with the 12 missing cases built and run 2026-10-05
note: Trigger does not reach the defect (2026-10-11, gdb on the host -O0 build): sqlite3Fts3Offsets runs twice and all three fts3EvalRestart calls come after both of them, so no saved poslist pointer is ever read across a restart. Upstream 51dd67080a fixes it by cancelling the incremental phrases BEFORE the pointers are taken (sqlite3Fts3MsrCancel from a new fts3ExprRestartIfCb), which is the ordering this trigger never produces.
